Program:
Crossover Code for:
• Primary Program: Musculoskeletal
(MSK) - Pain Management
• Companion Program: Sleep
Management
(See External Notation column for
more details.)
External Notation:
This is a crossover code that can be requested
under two programs: MSK Pain Management or
Sleep Management.
• If your request is intended to be used for Sleep
Management only, please submit your request
under the Sleep Management program through
the CareCoreNational platform.
• If your request is intended to be used for MSK
Pain, please submit your request under the MSK
Pain program through the MedSolutions
platform.
